probabilities.method: logistic(P(home win | no tie) ~ predicted margin) + smoothed regular-season tie base rate since 2017; tie = 0 in playoffs
probabilities.calibration_data: walk-forward out-of-fold predictions of the same model

production.selection_rule: Lowest mean of margin RMSE and total RMSE pooled over tune+dev seasons at the final horizon, ties broken by simplicity. C_resid(core_qb) 12.94 vs market-only 12.95: statistically indistinguishable from the market benchmark (paired CIs include zero).
production.early_horizon_note: No free timestamped historical lines exist, so the combined model is validated only at the final horizon. Early releases apply it to the line observed at release time and are labelled accordingly; early-horizon accuracy is measured prospectively.

corrections.summary: Release rel_20260925T132351Z (first The Odds API forecasts): the market 'retrieved_at' time recorded is when the request was SENT (2026-09-25T13:23:46.246644Z); the response arrived about one second later, so some bookmakers' update times (latest 2026-09-25T13:23:47Z) are after the recorded retrieval time. Every line was still received and provider-updated before the forecast was generated (13:23:51Z) and before every kickoff. From the next request on, the retrieval time is the response-received time and a line counts as available only from the later of the two times.
